questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the active or passive voice.**

Celebrate the New Year with amazing offers.

options.text: The New Year should be celebrated with amazing offers.
Let the New Year be celebrated with amazing offers.
Amazing offers will be celebrate in the New Year.
The New Year will be celebrated with amazing offers.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Let the New Year be celebrated with amazing offers**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is an **imperative sentence**. A **sentence that expresses a request, advice, or order** is called an **imperative sentence **(here,** an order**).
 
• An **imperative sentence in the passive voice** has the following form: **Let + object + be + past participle**.
 
• The three rules for converting imperative sentences from active voice into passive voice:
 
 
• The i**mperative sentence in the passive voice** always **starts with** the word '**Let**'.
 
• The word '**be**' is used as an **auxiliary** in the **passive voice**.
 
• In the **imperative sentences**, the **first form of the verb in the active voice** (here, **celebrate**) is changed into the **third form of the verb in the passive voice** (here, **celebrated**).

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य imperative sentence है। एक वाक्य जो अनुरोध, सलाह या आदेश व्यक्त करता है उसे imperative sentence (यहां, एक आदेश) कहा जाता है।
 
• Passive voice में एक imperative sentence का निम्न रूप है: Let + object + be + past participle.
 
• Imperative sentences को active voice से passive voice में बदलने के तीन नियम:
 
 
• Passive voice में imperative sentence हमेशा 'Let' शब्द से शुरू होता है।
 
• Passive voice में 'be' शब्द का प्रयोग **सहायक के रूप में** किया जाता है।
 
• Imperative sentences में, active voice में क्रिया का पहला रूप (यहां, celebrate) passive voice में क्रिया के तीसरे रूप में बदल जाता है (यहां, celebrated)।

 
 
 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

He said to his sister, “Please help me with my homework.”

options.text: His sister told him that he should help her with her homework.
His sister was asked by her brother that she should help him with his homework.
He told his sister that she should help him with his homework.
He requested his sister to help him with his homework.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **He requested his sister to help him with his homework**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed.
 
• 'Please' indicates a request and therefore, the **reporting verb** 'requested' should be used in place of 'please' and it **must be** **followed by an object**.
 
• **Requests** are usually **reported using** a **to-infinitive** (here, **to help**).
 
• The **first-person pronoun 'me'** becomes the **third-person pronoun 'him'** and the **first-person pronoun 'my'** becomes the **third-person pronoun 'his'**.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas और exclamation mark हटा दिए जाते हैं।
 
• 'Please' एक अनुरोध को इंगित करता है और इसलिए, 'Please' के स्थान पर रिपोर्टिंग क्रिया 'requested' का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Requests को आमतौर पर to-infinitive (यहां, to help) का उपयोग करके रिपोर्ट किया जाता है।
 
• First-person pronoun 'me', third-person pronoun 'him' बन जाता है और first-person pronoun 'my', third-person pronoun 'his' बन जाता है।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The given word '**Malicious**' means **characterized by malice; intending or intended to do harm**. (विद्वेषी, दुर्भावनाशील)

 
 
• Example: *Sam is not **malicious** and has no political leanings*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• 'Biased' means **to influence somebody or something, especially unfairly; to give an advantage to one group, etc**. (अनुचित रूप से किसी को प्रभावित करना, पक्षपात करना, तरफ़दारी करना; पक्षपात के लिए प्रेरित करना)
 
 
• Example: *University funding was tremendously **biased** towards scientists*.
 
 
 
• 'Perverted' means **to change a system, process, etc. in a bad way**. (किसी प्रणाली, प्रक्रिया आदि को बदल कर विकृत या भ्रष्‍ट कर देना)

• Example: *He is an educated, amiable and **decent** man*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

• The synonyms of the word 'Malicious' are "**malign**, bad, hateful".

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Mandatory
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Imperative.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word '**Mandatory**' means **forcing one's compliance or participation by or as if by law**. (क़ानूनन आवश्‍यक, अनिवार्य)

 
 
• Example: *A reply to this letter is **mandatory***.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of given options:-
 
 
• '**Unnecessary**' means **not needed**. (ग़ैर-ज़रूरी, अनावश्‍यक या अनपेक्षित, व्‍यर्थ का)
 
 
• Example: *In writing this report I have omitted all **unnecessary** details*.
 
 
 
• '**Imperative**' means **giving an authoritative command**. (एक आधिकारिक आदेश देना)
 
 
• Example: *We consider it absolutely **imperative** to start work immediately*.
 
 
 
• '**Impervious**' means **not affected or influenced by something**. (जिस पर किसी बात का असर नहीं होता या जो किसी के असर में नहीं आता; अप्रभावनीय)
 
 
• Example: *She was completely **impervious** to criticism*.
 
 
 
• '**Optional**' means something **that you can choose or not choose**. (वैकल्पिक जिसे आप चुन या छोड़ सकते हैं)
 
 
• Example: *Certain courses are compulsory, others are **optional***.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
